integrity: Analytical proof and finite exact-rational/numerical verification. Not independently audited. No claim of exhaustive prior-art uniqueness or of conflict with results that assume nonnegative covariance.
scientific_limitations: Two-column normalized real full-rank matrix, fixed positive iid coordinate sampling, nonzero inner product, exact arithmetic; asymptotic expected squared-error factor rather than pathwise or general batch guarantees.
title: An exact covariance-sign reversal and sharp one-eighth rate gap in two-coordinate randomized least squares
